title: Hackathon project for MariaDB's Wikipedia Through Time challenge: matching sentences across seven Wikipedia editions at any past date [P]
summary: Built at Junction, a hackathon in Espoo, this weekend. Parallax takes an article and lines up its Finnish, Swedish, German, English, Russian, Estonian and Ukrainian editions statement by statement. For any past date it shows where the editions tell something differently. We store
